environment: Extracted Debian package from /tmp, temporary XDG profile, private GTK X11 and synthetic freedesktop notification server
checks: Save error keeps the live draft
Real editor saved daily recurrence and refreshed marker
Notifications default off with no service calls
Real delete and undo preserve reminder identity
Real coordinator delivered through session-bus Notify
Repeated reminder poll does not duplicate delivery
Notification date action opens correct calendar month
Independent reopen sees saved item and delivery ledger
Notification opt-out persists in validated config
limitations: No native Mint apt/login/resume/physical monitor or actual Xfce notification presentation claim.
